task_instance: Reconcile this month's payroll run pulled from the Gusto API against a sample headcount.csv (5 employees), flagging id mismatches (paid-but-inactive, active-but-unpaid, wrong gross amount) and writing payroll_reconciliation.md with a table and summary for the controller.
blocker_detail: Step 1 of the skill requires calling the real Gusto API (GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/payrolls) with a bearer token pulled from a 'finance vault'. No Gusto account, company_id, or API token exists in this sandbox (verified via env vars: none set), and the sandbox rules forbid searching for or using credentials/secrets or accessing paid/account-bound services. A test curl to the Gusto API without a token was also blocked at the network proxy (403). Since the payroll data must come from a real, authoritative Gusto payroll run (the whole point is reconciling against the company's actual paid amounts), fabricating a stand-in payroll export would not exercise or verify the skill's real deliverable, so I stopped at this blocker rather than working around it with invented data.
